text: Coop Nordland SA is a Norwegian cooperative (samvirkeforetak, Brønnøysund 946231819) owned by its members; per its CEO the surplus of its operations is returned to the members and local communities through the cooperative model.
short: Coop Nordland is a member-owned cooperative.
